name: Triple confluence, dxy-armed: extreme fear + funding flush + a strong-dollar macro headwind cross
rationale: Thesis: crypto capitulations are sharpest when a macro liquidity headwind — a strengthening US dollar — is squeezing risk assets at the same moment the crypto crowd panics (fear_greed extreme-low) and perp leverage flushes (funding_rate low). The dollar axis is the macro trigger; sentiment + funding are the crypto-internal capitulation confirms. dxy DRIFTS, so it is used ONLY via cross_up (the dollar STRENGTHENING into the flush), never a raw level. The bounce is bought as the dollar-driven forced-selling exhausts. Long-only spot, medium hold. Disconfirmer: must beat the fear+funding pair WITHOUT the dxy cross arm on deflated Sharpe after fees; if the pair matches, the dollar axis adds no timing and is noise. Honest FAIL valid.
catalyst: a strengthening-dollar cross coinciding with extreme fear and a funding flush
